_notes: Structural support per material and world: [max support, min support, vertical loss, horizontal loss]. A piece on the ground has the max; every other piece takes a neighbour's support minus loss x distance (+0.1) x that support, and breaks below the min. support.py uses these.

Ravenholt: the server runs Cornerstone (VentureValheim), which replaces these values and syncs them to every player. The local .cfg in the LocalTesting profile is NOT what applies (it says 0.001); the synced values are read from the plugin in the running game: python support.py --read Ravenholt (while on that server).

What Ravenholt's values mean: stone loses 0.05 instead of 0.125 going up, so about 21 courses (42 m) stand instead of 8 (16 m), and 0.05 instead of 1.0 going sideways, so stone can jut out; wood loses 0.05 both ways (about 40 m); core wood is unchanged.

default_world: the world a check uses when a build names none. A world's 'before': the next boss its group has not killed; check.py flags materials it or a later boss opens (2026-10-05, Ravenholt: moder).
